audience: Control Plane operators and app-server client builders
candidate_text: Codex app-server `thread/list` now has experimental `parentThreadId` filtering, so clients can page a thread's direct spawned children from persisted spawn-edge state instead of scanning unrelated threads. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/26662
caveats: Keep the claim scoped to direct spawned children.
Do not imply Review or Guardian threads participate in this parent filter.

claims.text: Codex app-server thread/list now accepts experimental parentThreadId.
The parent filter is an adoption candidate for Control Plane child-thread snapshots.

decision.reason: The merged PR has a concrete app-server operator workflow with source-backed docs, protocol, storage, and test evidence.

evidence_notes: State DB listing filters by persisted `thread_spawn_edges.parent_thread_id`.
README docs show a `thread/list` request and response for direct child threads.
next_steps: Let Publisher automation decide whether to reserve or publish this candidate.
